newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends weaker on dollar short covering.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends weaker on dollar short covering.

text.p: The won closed slightly down versus the dollar on Tuesday as banks covered their short dollar positions following the central bank's rumoured dollar buying on Monday, traders said.
However, the earlier loss was eased as the short covering abated in the afternoon, they said.
The won closed at an intraday high of 892.00 against Monday's closing of 891.70. It opened at 892.30 and hit the low of 892.80 in early trading.
Dealers said the dollar's rise against the Japanese yen in world markets also weakened the local unit.
